title: Tensor-unit formula predicate for scalar/pullback quotient coordinates
statement: The predicate ScalarPullbackQuotientFormula records the displayed tensor-unit equation for a strict scalar/pullback quotient coordinate isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 06YY, 07A4 and 0941: the normalized tensor-unit coordinate equation
